name: Code Repository Manager
description: Registers configured Git repositories as Agent context and prepares Git authentication before runtime sessions start.

capabilities.name: code-repositories.md
capabilities.description: Exposes configured repository metadata to the Agent context system.

capabilities.name: beforeSessionCreate
capabilities.description: Checks Git CLI availability and prepares session-level Git authentication environment.

properties.name: contextInjection.mode
properties.description: Controls when repository context is exposed to the model.

properties.name: repositories
properties.description: Configured Git repositories. When omitted, the plugin reads host context repositories.json if present.

properties.name: auth.strategy
properties.description: Git authentication strategy used when preparing runtime sessions.

properties.name: auth.token
properties.description: Git token used when auth.strategy is token. Prefer auth.tokenEnv for packaged plugins.

properties.name: auth.tokenEnv
properties.description: Environment variable name containing the Git token used when auth.strategy is token.

properties.name: auth.username
properties.description: Git username used with token authentication.

properties.name: auth.privateKey
properties.description: SSH private key used when auth.strategy is ssh. Prefer auth.privateKeyEnv for packaged plugins.

properties.name: auth.privateKeyEnv
properties.description: Environment variable name containing the SSH private key used when auth.strategy is ssh.

properties.name: auth.knownHosts
properties.description: Known hosts content used with SSH authentication.

properties.name: auth.knownHostsEnv
properties.description: Environment variable name containing known hosts content used with SSH authentication.

properties.name: auth.helper
properties.description: Git credential.helper value used when auth.strategy is credential_helper.

properties.name: auth.helperEnv
properties.description: Environment variable name containing a Git credential.helper value.
